name: ZeroLimit v1.1.3
body:
> ⚠️ **Note**: macOS builds won't be code-signed unless you add Apple signing secrets. Unsigned macOS apps require users to run:
> ```bash
> xattr -cr /Applications/ZeroLimit.app
> ```


## What's Changed
* feat(onboarding): introduce new user onboarding and CLI Proxy setup by @0xtbug in https://github.com/0xtbug/zero-limit/pull/21
* docs(github): add issue templates for bug reports and feature requests by @0xtbug in https://github.com/0xtbug/zero-limit/pull/22
* feat(providers): introduce `PLUS_ONLY_PROVIDERS` constant to identify CLIPROXYAPI VERSION by @0xtbug in https://github.com/0xtbug/zero-limit/pull/24
* feat(proxy): add ability to switch between standard and plus versions by @0xtbug in https://github.com/0xtbug/zero-limit/pull/25


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/0xtbug/zero-limit/compare/v1.1.2...v1.1.3

body:
